text:
Type: thin light wood picture frame with mat
Use: displaying a print, poster or photo on a wall; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, Japandi
Materials: slim frame in a light birch-effect finish, white mat board, glass front
Colors: light natural wood, white mat
Shape: tall rectangular frame with a very slim flat profile, wide white mount around the picture, clean and light
Feel: calm, clean, airy, simple
Goes with: art prints, light wood furniture, white walls, black accents; Scandinavian, Japandi or minimalist rooms

product.name: MOSSEBO
product.description: You can choose to frame your picture in different ways; close to the front or behind the box frame insert to add depth. And with or without the accompanying mount.
